# telnyx_porting_order_verification_code_send (Action)

Sends verification codes to the phone numbers of a porting order.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.

### Optional

- `phone_numbers` (List of String)
- `verification_method` (String) One of `call`, `sms`.
